label: role()
type: the sync-function helper that assigns a role to a user (an alternative to doing so via the Admin REST API). Tolerates forward references: assigning a not-yet-created role is not an error, and once the role is later created, prior document revisions' role() calls retroactively take effect.
note: Uses the same 'role:'-prefix convention as requireRole()'s rolename argument (sgw:role-name-prefix-convention) - mandatory here (throws if absent), versus access()'s optional use of the identical prefix on its polymorphic username argument.
